q: CLOSED — Maddy & Cora, Harley & Yvaine, Violet & Nova, Izzy & Fiona.
detail: Maddy and Cora open the arc. Harley had been holding the question since Arc 7, and the wedding was rope-themed. Violet and Nova married like the sporting wives they are. Izzy and Fiona, already married, took a Found Family ceremony to be honoured properly.
